preconditions.description: The number of vertices N must be between 3 and 200,000.
The number of queries M must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= Ui <= N and 1 <= Vi <= N for Ui, Vi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge vertices must be within the range of 1 to N.

preconditions.expression: all(Pi != Q and 1 <= Pi <= N and 1 <= Qi <= N for Pi, Qi in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query must have valid vertices P and Q, and P must not be equal to Q.

preconditions.expression: all(any(Pi == neighbor for neighbor in graph[Pi]) for Pi, _ in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query, P must have at least two neighbors.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly M lines, one for each query.
Each output line must represent a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(line) <= N for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line must represent a valid length within the range of 1 to N.
